why: A_to_B: (a) is covering_restrict. For (b), V is the W of the non-item theorem_8_5_3_of_naturalRep; B's connected natural action (U, Φr, Γr) is a project NaturalRep, hence C.R for a chart C, and the witnesses are C.geometricLift and C.Ψ hF (properties from hA). Lg, A and Φ are actionEpGroupoid, geometricLiftFunctor and C.Φ rebuilt without ULift, since B's morphisms are G_x × U(x), not ULift G_x × U(x). B_to_A compiles but takes only (a) from B. theorem_8_5_8 (b) is the non-item theorem_8_5_3, and the chart-witness theorems, including theorem_8_5_8 (c), are re-proved outright. That (c) holds for every chart, i.e. any U(x) with the conclusion of Theorem 8.5, and adds (geometricLiftFunctor L).IsProperCovering (Prop. 8.5.7). B gives neither: its lifts are existential and exist only for U inside an unspecified V, and it never says A is a proper covering. So B's content is contained in A's, and A's extra scope does not follow from B. This is a difference of scope only: both readings of 'sufficiently small U(x) as in Theorem 8.5.3' are faithful.
overlap: B_to_A: 961 shared project theorems, no item theorem. Most are M-polyfold, sigma-polyfold and ep-groupoid infrastructure. The rest are the project's own proof of Theorem 8.6, copied: the non-item chart lemmas (full_Φ, full_Ψ, injective_Φ_mor, injective_Ψ_obj/mor, isLocalScDiffeo_Φ_mor/Ψ_mor, mor_σSrc, σSrc_comp, σSrc_id, morOn_U_eq, preimage_eq, …), theorem_8_5_3 / theorem_8_5_3_of_naturalRep (with Chapter 7's theorem_7_1_13) and proposition_8_5_7 with its geometric-lift lemmas. A_to_B uses from hA: covering_restrict, nonempty_fiberCat, isFullyFaithfulOpenEmbedding_Ψ, range_Ψ_obj, range_Ψ_mor and comp_Ψ.
